fieldValues.title: The owner's attention is the single sink
fieldValues.statement: Affirming meaning, ruling, merging and receiving reports each end in an act only I can do, so the whole flow waits on my attention. Each fix so far moves the act to a new place (a desk, a control room, a session) instead of removing it, and the work I have already judged still waits.
source_ref: Flow model B, across the stages (container b9c5106b)
Work-flow audit 2026-10-23: all 254 merges through the owner
